title.zh: Anthropic给Claude开「红队权限」：安全机构可做授权渗透测试
title.en: Anthropic给Claude开「红队权限」：安全机构可做授权渗透测试

current_state.zh: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers — Defense, Red Team, and Specialized — granting vetted security organizations reduced cybersecurity guardrails on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1, with the Red Team tier allowing authorized penetration testing and reportedly completing 34 of 50 complex attack tasks that were fully blocked on the standard model.
